title: Vedanāya
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Cakkhusamphassajā bhikkhave vedanā aniccā vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī || Sotasamphassajā vedanā || pa || || Jivhāsamphassajā vedanā || pa || Manosamphassajā vedanā aniccā vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī || || 4-6 Yo bhikkhave ime dhamme || pe || sambodhiparāyano ti || || [page 227] XXV. 10. 4] OKKANTIKA-SAṂYUTTA 227
